data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to present this modern townhouse in the vibrant community of Al Furjan.

Discover the stunning townhouses at Al Furjan North Village Phase – now available for you to explore and experience!

Located just adjacent to Discovery Gardens, this exceptional development offers one of two unique architectural styles. The design beautifully combines North African architectural elements with a blend of Islamic and Mediterranean townhouse styles, all thoughtfully crafted for warmer climates.

Property Details:

4 Bedrooms
5 Bathrooms
4 Parking Spaces
Community View

This property features a spacious living and dining area, a well-equipped kitchen, multiple bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, and a private garden. The design ensures privacy, comfort, and tranquility, making it the perfect choice for families seeking a peaceful retreat within a thriving community.
